// Get base64 PDF from binary download
const binaryKey = Object.keys($input.item.binary)[0];
const base64PDF = $input.item.binary[binaryKey].data;

if (!base64PDF) {
  throw new Error('No PDF binary data received from Supabase Storage');
}

// Load extraction prompt from environment or use inline
const systemPrompt = `You are a mortgage document parser specializing in Texas TREC One to Four Family Residential Contract (Resale) forms. Extract all fields from the attached contract PDF.

RULES:
- Return ONLY a valid JSON object. No markdown, no code blocks, no explanation.
- If a field cannot be found, use null — do not guess or fabricate values.
- Calculate option_expiration as effective_date + option_period_days if not explicitly stated.
- All dates must be formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.
- All monetary values must be numbers (no dollar signs, no commas).
- buyer_names and buyer_emails must be arrays even if only one buyer.`;

const userPrompt = `Extract all contract fields and return as a single JSON object with these exact keys. Use null for missing fields. Return raw JSON only — no markdown.

{
  "buyer_names": [],
  "buyer_emails": [],
  "seller_names": [],
  "seller_emails": [],
  "buyer_agent_name": null,
  "buyer_agent_email": null,
  "buyer_agent_phone": null,
  "buyer_agent_brokerage": null,
  "listing_agent_name": null,
  "listing_agent_email": null,
  "listing_agent_phone": null,
  "listing_agent_brokerage": null,
  "property_address": null,
  "city": null,
  "state": "TX",
  "zip": null,
  "county": null,
  "legal_description": null,
  "sales_price": null,
  "cash_at_closing": null,
  "loan_amount": null,
  "earnest_money": null,
  "option_fee": null,
  "option_period_days": null,
  "effective_date": null,
  "closing_date": null,
  "option_expiration": null,
  "title_company_name": null,
  "title_company_address": null,
  "title_contact_name": null,
  "title_contact_email": null,
  "title_contact_phone": null,
  "seller_concessions": null,
  "hoa": null,
  "home_warranty_amount": null,
  "property_condition": null,
  "survey_provided": null,
  "special_provisions": null,
  "loan_type": null,
  "down_payment_pct": null,
  "estimated_ltv": null,
  "missing_fields": []
}`;

const claudeBody = {
  model: 'claude-opus-4-6',
  max_tokens: 4096,
  system: systemPrompt,
  messages: [
    {
      role: 'user',
      content: [
        {
          type: 'document',
          source: {
            type: 'base64',
            media_type: 'application/pdf',
            data: base64PDF
          }
        },
        {
          type: 'text',
          text: userPrompt
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
};

return [{ json: { claudeBody } }];

const f = $('Parse Contract Fields').first().json; const val = (v) => (v !== null && v !== undefined && v !== '') ? v : '[MISSING]'; const fmt$ = (n) => n ? '$' + Number(n).toLocaleString('en-US') : '[MISSING]'; const fmtDate = (d) => { if (!d) return '[MISSING]'; return new Date(d + 'T00:00:00').toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' }); }; const buyerNames = Array.isArray(f.buyer_names) && f.buyer_names.length ? f.buyer_names.join(' & ') : '[MISSING]'; const sellerNames = Array.isArray(f.seller_names) && f.seller_names.length ? f.seller_names.join(' & ') : '[MISSING]'; const subject = `Under Contract \u2013 ${val(f.property_address)} | ${buyerNames}`; const html = `

Hey team,

Thanks for getting this over \u2014 excited to work on this one together. I've reviewed the contract and wanted to confirm the key details on my end and lay out next steps from the lending side.

DEAL SUMMARY

Property: ${val(f.property_address)}
Buyer(s): ${buyerNames}
Sales Price: ${fmt$(f.sales_price)}
Loan Amount: ${fmt$(f.loan_amount)}
Down Payment: ~${val(f.down_payment_pct)}%
Earnest Money: ${fmt$(f.earnest_money)}
Option Fee: ${fmt$(f.option_fee)}
Option Period Expires: ${fmtDate(f.option_expiration)}
Closing Date: ${fmtDate(f.closing_date)}
Seller Concessions: ${fmt$(f.seller_concessions)}
Title Company: ${val(f.title_company_name)}

NEXT STEPS FROM LENDING

  1. Loan registered and disclosures issued
  2. Rate locked
  3. File submitted to processing and underwriting
  4. Appraisal ordered once we have initial approval
  5. Clear to close targeted ahead of ${fmtDate(f.closing_date)}

I'll keep everyone in the loop on milestone updates as we move through the process. If anything changes on the contract side, please let me know right away so we can stay aligned.

TRANSACTION PARTIES

Buyer(s): ${buyerNames}
Seller(s): ${sellerNames}
Buyer's Agent: ${val(f.buyer_agent_name)} \u2014 ${val(f.buyer_agent_brokerage)}
Listing Agent: ${val(f.listing_agent_name)} \u2014 ${val(f.listing_agent_brokerage)}
Title: ${val(f.title_company_name)} \u2014 ${val(f.title_contact_name)}
Lender: Adam Styer \u2014 Mortgage Solutions LP

Let me know if I'm missing anyone or if any of the above needs correcting. Let's get this closed.

Adam Styer
Senior Loan Officer | Mortgage Solutions LP
NMLS# 513013
(512) 956-6010
adam@thestyerteam.com

`; return [{ json: { subject, html, to: 'adam@thestyerteam.com', original_to: val(f.buyer_agent_email), original_cc: [f.listing_agent_email, f.title_contact_email].filter(Boolean).join(', ') } }];

const f = $('Parse Contract Fields').first().json; const val = (v) => (v !== null && v !== undefined && v !== '') ? v : '[MISSING]'; const fmt$ = (n) => n ? '$' + Number(n).toLocaleString('en-US') : '[MISSING]'; const fmtDate = (d) => { if (!d) return '[MISSING]'; return new Date(d + 'T00:00:00').toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' }); }; const buyerNames = Array.isArray(f.buyer_names) && f.buyer_names.length ? f.buyer_names.join(' & ') : '[MISSING]'; const buyerFirstNames = Array.isArray(f.buyer_names) && f.buyer_names.length ? f.buyer_names.map(n => n.split(' ')[0]).join(' & ') : '[MISSING]'; const buyerEmails = Array.isArray(f.buyer_emails) && f.buyer_emails.length ? f.buyer_emails.join(', ') : null; const subject = `Welcome \u2013 Your Loan for ${val(f.property_address)} | Adam Styer`; const html = `

Hi ${buyerFirstNames},

Congratulations on getting under contract on ${val(f.property_address)} \u2014 that's a big deal and I'm glad to be working with you on the financing side.

I wanted to reach out personally to introduce myself and walk you through what happens next so there are no surprises.

WHAT HAPPENS FROM HERE

  1. Document Collection \u2014 If we need any additional documents from you, you can upload them directly through your loan portal below. The faster we get everything in, the faster we move.
  2. Processing & Underwriting \u2014 Once everything is submitted, our team reviews and works toward an initial approval.
  3. Appraisal \u2014 We'll order the appraisal once we have approval. This confirms the home's value for the lender.
  4. Clear to Close \u2014 Once all conditions are met, we issue the clear to close and you'll receive your final closing numbers.
  5. Closing Day \u2014 Currently scheduled for ${fmtDate(f.closing_date)}. You sign, you fund, you get the keys.

Loan Portal \u2014 Upload Documents

IMPORTANT \u2014 PROTECT YOUR APPROVAL

From now until you have your keys in hand, please avoid the following:

  • Do not open any new credit accounts or make large purchases
  • Do not move or transfer large sums of money between accounts
  • Do not change jobs or employment status
  • Do not co-sign on anything
  • Do not miss any payments on existing accounts

Any of these can delay or jeopardize your closing. When in doubt, call me first.

YOUR DEAL AT A GLANCE

Property: ${val(f.property_address)}
Sales Price: ${fmt$(f.sales_price)}
Target Closing: ${fmtDate(f.closing_date)}
Your Agent: ${val(f.buyer_agent_name)}

HOW TO REACH ME

I'm available by call, text, or email. If something comes up or you have a question at any point in this process \u2014 reach out. That's what I'm here for.

Call or text: (512) 956-6010
Email: adam@thestyerteam.com
Schedule a call: Book Time on My Calendar

Looking forward to getting this done for you.

Adam Styer
Senior Loan Officer | Mortgage Solutions LP
NMLS# 513013
(512) 956-6010
adam@thestyerteam.com

`; return [{ json: { subject, html, to: 'adam@thestyerteam.com', original_to: buyerEmails } }];
